prompts.T3_prompt:
Write a complete textbook-style English explanation for the following problem. Preserve the given values and conditions. Include a Solution heading, derivation, units and applicability assumptions. Return only the explanation.

PROBLEM:
prompts.rewrite_prompt: Rephrase the complete English teaching explanation below. Preserve all formulas, numerical values, units, variable bindings, assumptions, conditions, causal relations and conclusions. Do not answer a different problem. Return only the rewritten explanation.

attacks.light: Lightly rephrase the following English explanation sentence by sentence. Preserve its structure and all formulas, numerical values, units, assumptions, applicability conditions, conclusions and scientific meaning. Change only wording; do not summarize or add information. Return only the revised text.
attacks.concise: Preserve all formulas, numerical values, units, assumptions, applicability conditions, reasoning results and scientific meaning. Remove decorative wording, redundant explanations and unnecessary transitions. Aim for {ratio}% of the input word count. Do not solve a different problem. Return only the revised text.

KGW.threshold: z>3; not FPR-matched to other methods

RC: global-only key k4; random permitted token-safe positions; structure mask off; same remaining constraints
domain_null_adoption: Explicit EVAL03 task revision, not retroactive EVAL02 modification
